message.content:
This editorial illustration features a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large, white, serif capital letters. Below it, an illustrated man with dark hair and exaggerated facial features stands wearing a blue suit, a white shirt, and a red tie. His arms are bent at the elbows, and his hands are open with palms facing upward in a shrugging or welcoming gesture. To his left stands a black, high-backed executive chair with light-colored, curved armrests. The chair's surface features multiple white glints or sparkle marks.

The background is a textured, golden-brown wall with vertical rectangular recessed panels. Text on the cover includes the slogan "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" and headlines like "Korupsi Tata Ruang Yogya H.70" and "Di Balik Mandeknya PLTS Atap H.82". The main headline reads "KOMPROMI GANTI MENTERI" in large white font. Beneath it, text states, "Jokowi mengganti dua menteri dan memasukkan tiga wakil menteri baru dalam kabinetnya. Kompromi menjelang Pemilu 2024 dan mengakomodasi kepentingan para juragan partai. H.28". A barcode and QR code appear in the top right.
